projects.name: (Value-Added-Services-Platform) - Kodiak  Client: Leading U.S. Telecom Provider
details: Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, REST API, Microservices, Docker and Kubernetes (K8s), Cassandra DB, Design Patterns, JUnit/Mockito, GitLab (CI/CD), Splunk, Jira.

Description: Contribution to backend development of VASP-Kodiak project within the telecom domain, enabling real-time provisioning of subscribers based on NAP events and integration with partners via the APIGEE gateway.
Achievements / Responsibilities:

Developed REST APIs for Kodiak (NAP listener and Partner notify services) and other VASP Projects like TPM, PaloAlto, and ONS. Implemented create, update, and delete subscriber operations driven by NAP events for Kodiak.

Deployed services in a Kubernetes (K8s) environment using ArgoCD. Performed feature enhancements, bug fixes, unit and integration testing (JUnit/Mockito). Worked on GitLab pipeline and sonar integration for Kodiak.
Participated in requirement analysis, design discussions, and architecture planning. Monitored and addressed production alerts for my projects via Splunk.

projects.client: Public and Private Enterprises (Wholesalers, Sellers, Trusts, Banks, NGOs, Hotels, Malls, etc.)
details: Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, Redis, REST APIs, Microservices, Design Patterns, Kafka, AWS S3, JUnit/Mockito, Bitbucket, Jira, Jenkins

Description: Designed and developed a scalable onboarding platform to register diverse merchant types across multiple sectors. Enabled modular onboarding flows based on merchant category and solution preferences (e.g., QR Mapping, Soundbox, EDC, Fastag). We first onboard the merchant, followed by onboarding the selected solutions based on their preferences by generating a corresponding lead in the system.
Achievements / Responsibilities:

Contributed to the backend development of OE–Devices Charter and OE–Panel teams using Java-based microservices architecture. Led the end-to-end integration of a new Bank Channel Partner Solution - developed the complete flow from file upload to lead creation across multiple services.

Designed and implemented modules and REST APIs across microservices including Merchant Subscription, Bank Channel Lead Creation, Order Management, Payment Gateway, ATS, and EGS, with integrated ATS/IoT services for automated device tracking and provisioning.

Participated in requirement analysis, design discussions, and architecture planning. Performed enhancements, bug fixes, unit and integration testing (JUnit/Mockito), peer code reviews, and provided mentoring support within the team.

projects.name: (Advanced Toll-Free) Application  Client: Telecom Industry
details: Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, REST APIs, Redis, SQL, Microservices, JUnit/Mockito, Git, Jira, Design Patterns

Description: Developed an enterprise-level toll-free number management platform supporting advanced features like payphone handling, origin/time/digit-based routing patterns, call routing logic, and super route plan configurations. Enabled end-to-end configuration and provisioning of toll-free services for telecom clients.
Achievements / Responsibilities:
Designed and developed backend services for features such as origin pattern, routing pattern, time pattern, and number blocking.

Integrated toll-free numbers with super route plans and route plan groups as per client-specific configurations. Deployed the ATF application on CAS (Communication Application Server) hosted on-premises. Utilized SPS (Service Provisioning System) for data provisioning and INC for network connectivity.

Participated in requirement analysis, design discussions, and technical planning. Handled enhancements, bug fixes, unit/integration testing, peer code reviews, and supported team collaboration efforts.

details: Technologies: Java, Spring MVC, Hibernate, JSP, SQL, Redis, REST APIs, SVN, Jira

Description: Developed a comprehensive banking solution focused on customer acquisition, loan lifecycle management, and delinquency handling. Executed enhancements, bug fixes, unit and integration testing, collaborated with peers for code reviews and issue resolution.
